subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: What CTWA attribution exposure boundary should WhatsApp inbound messages use for ad click identifiers?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but the requested value is an advertising click identifier and the issue asks for prompt, plugin, or session exposure, so automation should not choose the visibility or retention policy.

options.title: Typed plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Expose CTWA attribution to opted-in plugin hooks without putting the click ID into every agent prompt or durable session row by default.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted prompt context
options.body: Expose CTWA fields only in the existing fenced untrusted context for the current inbound turn and avoid persistence.

options.title: Persist first CTWA payload
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session metadata with explicit redaction, retention, and retrieval rules.

recommendation.title: Typed plugin-hook attribution payload
recommendation.body: Expose CTWA attribution to opted-in plugin hooks without putting the click ID into every agent prompt or durable session row by default.
